name: Deepgram
description: Speech-to-text and voice API with a generous trial credit.
overview: Deepgram serves Nova speech-to-text and Aura text-to-speech with $200 of starter credit. Current standard terms grant a perpetual default licence over content for storage, training, testing and improvement; a per-request training opt-out is available.
notes: Training on free-tier audio is on by default.
